a.lede: Jensen Huang admitted to more affairs than the two that Nvidia's board members were already aware of before they agreed to let him return to the company as CEO, President, and board member, amid reports that one of the women involved is a Chinese spy.
a.title: Jensen Huang confessed to more affairs before the board reinstated him as Nvidia CEO, report claims

b.lede: Nvidia has reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO, president, and a board member.
b.title: Nvidia reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO following unanimous vote by company board
